server: Plain dart:io HttpServer and WebSocketTransformer; one fresh process per case.
client: Separate process; eight simultaneous opens and 64 simultaneous closes.
messages: One verified 128-byte echo on every connection, followed by five seconds idle.
transport: Unencrypted loopback WebSocket; actual compression negotiation counted on server.
measurement: Server RSS only; no Cloud limit, Serverpod, database, or Offline Sync.
limitation: One run per point. RSS after close may reflect GC or allocator retention; this does not prove a leak.
